reason: The README describes an experimental DSH plugin that gives each agent a scope-local tool_search function to discover and progressively expose eligible global tools while preserving existing restrictions, making agent tool orchestration its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 为每个智能体提供按需工具发现和渐进式工具架构披露，并在不放宽现有限制的情况下加载选定的全局工具。
summaries.en: Provides per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure while loading selected global tools without widening existing restrictions.

capabilities: Per-agent discovery of deferred global tools
Progressive disclosure of selected tool schemas
Per-agent tool restriction and selection state restoration
Lexical search and ranking of available tool names and descriptions
